statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let N := fun (X : ℕ) => 2*X+5; let f := fun (X n : ℕ) => if n ∈ w X ∧ n.Prime then Real.log n else 0; let energy := fun (X : ℕ) => letI : NeZero (N X) := ⟨by dsimp [N]; omega⟩; ∑ k : ZMod (N X), (ZMod.stdAddChar (N:=N X) (2*k)).re * ‖ZMod.dft (fun j : ZMod (N X) => ((f X j.val:ℝ):ℂ)) k‖^2; ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ X : ℕ, B<X ∧ 0<energy X
